Stated Claim / Post Context:
Amy Robach and T.J. Holmes are married! Ex-GMA lovers wed in private Arkansas ceremony

The former Good Morning America journalists - Robach, 53, and Holmes, 49 - tied the knot on September 19 in an intimate affair.

Actual Article Body:
By EMMA RICHTER, US SENIOR NEWS REPORTER

Updated:  08:41 AEDT, 14 October 2026

Amy Robach and T.J. Holmes are officially husband and wife after the pair secretly married at a private ceremony in Arkansas.

The former Good Morning America journalists – Robach, 53, and Holmes, 49 – tied the knot on September 19 in an intimate affair in his home state.

Their nuptials come just four years after the Daily Mail exposed the couple's affair.

Robach and Holmes were suspended from GMA after their relationship was exposed in November 2022.

They divorced their partners, Marilee Fiebig and Andrew Shue, soon after.

In a twist of events, Fiebig and Shue started dating in 2023 and currently live together.

Holmes and Robach's wedding happened one day after they applied for a marriage license in Washington County, People reported.

The document was registered with the clerk's office on Tuesday, the outlet stated.

Amy Robach and T.J. Holmes are officially husband and wife after the pair secretly married at a private ceremony in Arkansas on September 19

They started hosting GMA together in 2020 in what sources said was a platonic relationship at first

Robach and Holmes announced their engagement on October 14, 2025, during an episode of their podcast Amy & T.J.

'We are sharing with all of you that we are engaged and we've been engaged for just about a month now,' Robach told listeners.

'We wanted to let you all know before anybody else was able to. We've learned that lesson, I guess, in the past about our relationship,' Holmes added, appearing to refer to Daily Mail's exclusive report.

In 2022, our exclusive photos showed the co-workers cozying up at a bar in New York City, spending alone time at their apartments, and enjoying a weekend getaway together at a secluded cottage in Upstate New York.

At the time, inside sources told the Daily Mail: 'Everyone knows that Amy and T.J. have been close friends for a long time now, running together and even socializing as a foursome with each other's spouses.'

Their friendship evolved in June of that year, if not sooner, 'when they were in London together filming the Queen's Diamond Jubilee for ABC and staff were buzzing about the intimacy between them.'

Up until then, their relationship, both on and off air, seemed platonic after they began anchoring GMA in 2020.

Each of them divorced their partners, Marilee Fiebig and Andrew Shue (pictured with Robach), soon after their affair was exposed

Fiebig (pictured with Holmes) and Shue started dating in 2023 and currently live together

After their secret was out, Robach and Holmes said they hit 'rock bottom.'

During a June 2024 episode of their podcast, Holmes told their guest, singer-songwriter Rachel Platten, that the couple attended her concert the night before, and Robach has been 'wiping tears from her face.'

Robach gushed over the musician before sharing how the 2015 hit 'Fight Song' had resonated with her.

'We know a little bit about walking through some darkness and coming through the other side and when the worst has happened,' Robach said. 'And I've thought I've hit rock bottom before and I actually hit rock bottom.'

She professed that the track had become her 'anthem' at the time of the couple's dramatic ouster from the morning television program.

Holmes, meanwhile, characterized the process of letting go as 'weird' but 'freeing.'

He said the experience was necessary to find 'where I'm supposed to be,' but conceded: 'It sucks. It sucks even more than you think.'

The duo launched their self-titled podcast in 2023, with the first episode releasing on December 5, exactly one year after their exit from GMA.

Robach and Holmes were 'temporarily removed' from the show in 2022 after rumors of their affair began to circulate. They were officially let go on January 27, 2023.

Shue wiped all traces of her from social media just days after news of the infidelity broke.

The couple tied the knot in 2008, following Robach's split from Tim McIntosh. They shared a blended family, including five children from previous marriages.

Holmes and his ex-wife divorced in December 2022 after reportedly separating that August.

The pair welcomed a baby girl in 2013 and were married for 12 years. Holmes has two other children, a son and a daughter, from his previous marriage with Amy Ferson.
